versioning_policy.review_only_refresh_note: A substantive-review date refresh or review-due status change does not by itself increment dataset_version. Regenerated packages remain distinguishable through package_updated_at and file integrity metadata.

notes: File counts and SHA-256 hashes are populated by the release-packaging step when the distributable ZIP is generated.

release_summary.release_note: Four authoritative sources are newly registered without EXTREQ extraction. Existing IEEE, EU and ISO/IEC continuation states remain explicit; source registration is not clause-level Compliance coverage.
